name: Metal Brite

features.text: Protects metal from corrosion and tarnish.
Multiuse for aviation, auto, marine and home.

description: A semiviscous, white cream that is a true metal-treatment. It deep cleans, using gentle, nonabrasive material. This product helps protect metal from corrosion and tarnishing for an amazing end result. Metal Brite ® can be used on chrome, aluminum, brass, copper, stainless steel, gold, silver, pewter, magnesium, fiberglass and tile.
application: Shake before using. 1.) Surface should be dry and clean. 2.) Apply a generous amount of Metal Brite® to a clean cloth or towel. 3.) Rub polish onto metal surface (black residue is a normal sign of deep cleaning) and continue rubbing until surface is clean. 4.) Buff off residue with a second clean cloth or towel. 5.) Continue to buff until glossy surface appears. Note : Not recommended for anodized or thinly plated metal surfaces.
review: Has a Performance Ratings section: Abrasiveness - 2 Gloss - 8 Durability - 6
